// Fixture — should be flagged.
//
// This file declares a local isValidID at package-private scope
// outside pkg/paths/ with no //nolint:cousinvalidator pragma.
// The cousinvalidator scan must report it as a Finding.

package fixture

func isValidID(id string) bool {
	if id == "" {
		return false
	}
	return true
}
